author: ReyCassie
body:
Dear Avicus staff team,

i know this was a long time ago but my infraction #123979 and #123980 was a double infraction but I got it for the same reason and same time. So it was a double infraction by different staff members. Also I don't think it was fair to have a double infraction.

Also my first infraction by Sunaye #117745 was a combat log and from the bottom of my heart I never knew what combat logging was then. 

Hopefully you will take my appeal incosideration. Thanks!

from KN10 (nemo1197)
